## History

Minnie May contracted severe croup while her parents were away, leaving [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to rush to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for assistance. Using her past experience caring for children, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully treated Minnie May and saved her life. This event led Mrs. [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) to forgive [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and permit her and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) to resume their friendship.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

Minnie May's life is saved by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) when Minnie May contracts a severe case of croup while her parents are away. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) uses her previous experience caring for children to treat the illness. As a result of this rescue, Minnie May's mother forgives [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and permits her to resume her close friendship with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--minnie-may.md)

[Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) is Minnie May's sister. When Minnie May falls dangerously ill with croup while their parents are away, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) rushes out to seek help to save her sister's life.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P1](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P31](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0031), +1 more_

- Sibling of  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P21](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
